# testing_x_match (Data Source)

XMatch DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_x_match" "my_xmatch" {
  id = "...my_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `object` (Attributes) Object for verifying nested match configuration (e.g. object.id) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--object))
- `unmatched_string` (String) Non x-speakeasy-match string property
